policies.attendance: Attendance and participation is required in order to succeed in this class. Excellent attendance will be rewarded. You must come to class to find out the reward!
policies.makeup: Failure to take both parts of the final exam as scheduled will result in a zero for each part. No make-up exams will be given, and may not substitute a unit exam grade for either part of the final.
policies.extra_credit: Opportunities for extra credit may include, but are not limited to, the following: Extra credit problems included in this course for each chapter 12 @ 4 points/each; Team practice in-class for each Unit 3 @ 10 points/each. Extra credit activities may have a combined possible total of more than 48 points; however, only 48 points may be applied toward your final course points and grade.

course_schedule: Weekly chapter sequence over the Spring 2026 term with Ready-for-Class, Assignment, Quiz, and SmartBook due dates per chapter; Exam 1 (Ch 1-4) around Feb 17-19, Exam 2 (Ch 5-8) Mar 30-Apr 3, Exam 3 (Ch 9-12) Apr 29-May 2, and a two-part Final Exam beginning May 11. Spring Break Mar 16-20.
distinctive_features: Points-based grading out of 1000 with a two-part final exam (Part 1 covers Chapters 1-6, Part 2 covers Chapters 7-12); extra credit is available but capped at 48 applied points.
full_summary: Principles of Financial Accounting (ACCT 2301), Spring 2026, Section 24: an introduction to GAAP-based financial accounting, financial statement preparation, and exposure to IFRS. Grading is points-based out of 1000: Ready-for-Class exercises (60), assignments (240), quizzes (60), a comprehensive problem (15), three unit exams (375), and a two-part final exam (250). No make-up exams are given, and both parts of the final are required. Extra credit is available but capped at 48 applied points. The withdraw deadline is April 16, 2026.
